minimumExpectation: Every report-driven GitHub coding agent run must include at least one advanced GameEngin or game upgrade. The mandatory game slice must target a non-trivial experience, not a simple tap-only loop.
engineStandards: Push GameEngin toward state-of-the-art feel: strong responsiveness, readable depth, and premium rendering or systems polish.
Prefer Babylon.js 8+ and WebGPU-first paths when rendering changes are involved, or deepen existing engine-grade gameplay systems already in the repo.
Upgrades must improve meaningful gameplay depth: combat, progression, AI, procedural variety, bosses, simulation, narrative systems, or competitive loops.
Do not spend the mandatory game slice on a simple tap-only game when an advanced target is available.
Every game upgrade must remain remote-ready, quick-resume friendly, and compatible with existing GameEngin launch/navigation patterns.

advancedTargets.label: Babylon Side Scroller
advancedTargets.why: Babylon-powered platformer with procedural zones, boss encounters, and room for deeper movement/combat polish.

advancedTargets.label: ENGINBattle
advancedTargets.why: Systems-heavy strategy game suited for stronger faction logic, AI, economy, or battlefield readability improvements.

advancedTargets.label: DREAMquest
advancedTargets.why: RPG structure supports richer quest chains, encounter depth, world-state progression, and more premium feedback loops.
